impact: Read the SSL-VPN session file, which holds usernames and plaintext passwords, without logging in
exploitedFirst: 2019-08 (n-day, after Black Hat 2019 talk; exact date UNVERIFIED)
notes: Advisory FG-IR-18-384 (Fortinet says it was resolved May 2019; the 2019-05-24 day is UNVERIFIED, NVD published 2019-06-04). Fortinet CNA scores it 9.1, NVD 9.8. In Sept 2021 a threat actor leaked SSL-VPN access data for 87,000 FortiGate devices; Fortinet said patched devices 'remain vulnerable' if passwords were not reset. Named as the probable entry point in the 2021 Tsurugi Town Handa Hospital (Japan) ransomware case. The 2022 Osaka General Medical Center report names a supplier's FortiGate VPN and possibly leaked credentials.

impact: Read files including cached plaintext credentials and session data without logging in
exploitedFirst: 2019-08-22 (n-day, mass scanning the day after a public exploit appeared)
notes: Vendor advisory SA44101. CISA AA20-010A (2020-01-10) reported continued wide exploitation. CISA AA20-107A warned that attackers who stole credentials kept access after patching if the credentials were not changed. Travelex (REvil/Sodinokibi, Dec 2019) was widely reported as hit through this CVE (press, secondary). Bad Packets counted 14,528 vulnerable endpoints in Aug 2019, with Japan second by country (secondary).

class: Path traversal leading to code execution
impact: Remote code execution on the appliance without logging in
notes: CTX267027 shipped mitigations only. Firmware fixes did not arrive until 2020-01-19 through 2020-01-24, so exploitation started before any patch existed (CISA AA20-020A / AA20-031A). 'Shitrix' is a community nickname.

impact: Read usernames, passwords and session information without logging in
notes: SonicWall disclosed a zero-day against its own systems on 2021-01-22 (press). NVD published the record 2021-02-04. Mandiant tied UNC2447 to zero-day use followed by FiveHands ransomware. Mandiant was quoted as saying the actors still held credentials from over 100 VPN appliances, and that those victims remained at risk after patching unless passwords were reset or MFA enabled (press quote, secondary).

impact: Remote code execution without logging in
notes: Vendor advisory SA44784, fix shipped 2021-05-03. Mandiant ('Check Your Pulse') attributed intrusions against defense, government and finance to UNC2630, possibly APT5. CISA issued Emergency Directive 21-03.

impact: Remote code execution on the firewall without logging in
exploitedFirst: 2022-10 (zero-day; MIVD says the actor had it at least two months before disclosure)
notes: Advisory FG-IR-22-398. Dutch MIVD/AIVD: COATHANGER malware survives reboots and firmware upgrades. In June 2024 the MIVD said the campaign reached more than 20,000 FortiGates in a few months across 2022-2023, about 14,000 of them during the zero-day window. This CVE is also one of the entry points Fortinet cited for the 2025 symlink persistence.

impact: Remote code execution without logging in
exploitedFirst: 2023-06 (Fortinet said it 'may have been exploited in a limited number of cases'; exact date UNVERIFIED)
notes: Advisory FG-IR-23-097. The nickname comes from the Lexfo researchers who found it. Fortinet listed it among the entry points behind the April 2025 symlink persistence.

impact: Remote code execution without logging in; web shell planted
notes: CISA AA23-201A: in June 2023 a web shell was dropped on a critical-infrastructure organization's NetScaler. The attackers decrypted an AD credential from config files and queried Active Directory. Segmentation stopped lateral movement to the domain controller.

class: Missing separation of authentication paths (lets attackers brute-force VPN credentials)
impact: Unauthenticated brute force of valid VPN username/password pairs; does not bypass MFA where MFA is enforced
exploitedFirst: 2023-03 (brute-force campaigns per Rapid7; exact date UNVERIFIED)
notes: Cisco scores it 5.0, NVD 9.1. Cisco PSIRT (2023-08-24) said Akira targeted Cisco VPNs without MFA. Akira and LockBit were reported using this flaw before the advisory (secondary). Good example that the credential layer itself is the attack surface.

class: Out-of-bounds memory read that leaks session tokens
impact: Steal a valid post-MFA session cookie and take over the session without username, password or MFA
notes: Citrix CNA scores it 9.4, NVD 7.5. CISA AA23-325A: LockBit 3.0 affiliates used it against Boeing Distribution Inc., and it 'allows threat actors to bypass password requirements and multifactor authentication'. Sessions hijacked before the patch kept working after patching, so sessions had to be killed. ICBC Financial Services (Nov 2023) was linked to CitrixBleed by press, citing a US Treasury email reported by WSJ and Kevin Beaumont. That link is UNVERIFIED in primary sources.

impact: Reach restricted resources without logging in; chained with CVE-2024-21887 for root-level command execution
notes: Prompted CISA Emergency Directive 24-01 (2024-01-19). Supplemental direction ordered agencies to disconnect all affected instances by 2024-02-02 and factory-reset before reconnecting. CISA AA24-060B: the Integrity Checker Tool missed compromises, and actors may keep root-level persistence through factory resets.

impact: Arbitrary command execution; unauthenticated when chained with CVE-2023-46805
notes: On its own it needs admin access. The real-world chain with CVE-2023-46805 is pre-auth. Covered by the same ED 24-01 and AA24-060B.

impact: Remote code execution without logging in
exploitedFirst: 2024-02 (vendor said 'potentially exploited' at disclosure; exact date UNVERIFIED)
notes: Advisory FG-IR-24-015. One of the entry points Fortinet named for the symlink persistence disclosed on 2025-04-10.

impact: Remote code execution on the firewall without logging in
notes: Volexity found it at a customer (actor UTA0218, 'highly likely' state-backed). The actor took firewall config and moved inward, taking NTDS.dit, DPAPI keys and browser login data and cookies.

product: Quantum Security Gateway (Remote Access VPN / Mobile Access)
impact: Read files such as local account password hashes without logging in; seen leading to NTDS.dit theft within hours
notes: Hotfix sk182336. Check Point first saw login attempts with old local VPN accounts that used password-only authentication. Its remediation includes resetting local-account and LDAP passwords and renewing certificates. watchTowr published technical detail on 2024-05-30.

impact: Unauthorized access to firewall resources; used for SSLVPN initial access by ransomware
notes: Advisory SNWLID-2024-0015. SonicWall's CVSS v3 is 9.3, NVD 9.8. In August 2025 SonicWall said a new Akira wave was not a zero-day. It had 'significant correlation' with this CVE, and many of the fewer than 40 incidents involved Gen 6 to Gen 7 migrations where local passwords were carried over and never reset.

class: Authentication bypass that hijacks active VPN sessions
impact: Take over a logged-in user's SSL VPN session (bypassing password and MFA) and open a tunnel into the network
exploitedFirst: 2025-02 (n-day, shortly after the PoC was published 2025-02-10)
notes: SonicWall scores it 8.2, NVD 9.8. Found by Computest, PoC by Bishop Fox. Bishop Fox counted about 4,500 internet-facing servers still unpatched on 2025-02-07.

impact: Remote code execution without logging in
notes: Mandiant attributes it to UNC5221. Its malware faked a successful upgrade (PHASEJAM) and copied itself into the new partition during a real upgrade (SPAWNANT). It also re-signed the Integrity Checker manifest. JPCERT/CC confirmed multiple Japanese victims from late December 2024.

impact: Remote code execution without logging in
notes: Ivanti scores it 9.0, NVD 9.8. Quietly fixed as a product bug in 22.7R2.6 on 2025-02-11. Mandiant assesses UNC5221 'likely studied the patch' and turned an apparent DoS into RCE.

class: Out-of-bounds memory read that leaks session tokens
impact: Leak session tokens from memory and hijack sessions, bypassing MFA
exploitedFirst: 2025-06 mid/late (n-day; before public PoCs on 2025-07-04/07; exact date UNVERIFIED)
notes: NVD v3.1 is 7.5. Citrix scores it CVSS v4 9.3. ReliaQuest reported hijacked sessions and MFA bypass around 2025-06-26. Citrix initially said it had no evidence of exploitation. Patching alone was not enough; active sessions had to be terminated. CISA gave agencies one day to patch.

impact: Remote code execution in practice; web shells planted
notes: NVD v3.1 is 9.8. Citrix scores it CVSS v4 9.2. KEV ransomware field is 'Unknown', recorded here as false. NCSC-NL said several critical Dutch organisations were breached, with traces erased, and that updating does not remove an existing compromise. The Dutch Public Prosecution Service disruption was press-reported.

impact: Remote code execution and/or DoS without logging in (Gateway/AAA configs)
exploitedFirst: 2025-08 (zero-day, exploited at disclosure; exact date UNVERIFIED)
notes: NVD v3.1 is 9.8. Citrix scores it CVSS v4 9.2. KEV ransomware field is 'Unknown'.

product: Secure Firewall ASA / FTD VPN web server
impact: Reach restricted VPN URL endpoints without logging in; chained with CVE-2025-20333 in ArcaneDoor
exploitedFirst: 2025-05 or earlier (zero-day; Cisco engaged by government agencies in May 2025)
notes: Cisco scores it 6.5, NVD 8.6. KEV ransomware field is 'Unknown'. Prompted CISA Emergency Directive 25-03.

product: Secure Firewall ASA / FTD VPN web server
impact: Code execution as root (needs VPN credentials alone; used with CVE-2025-20362)
notes: KEV ransomware field is 'Unknown'. CISA ED 25-03: the actor modified ASA ROM to persist through reboot and system upgrade, and security updates do 'not necessarily remove' an existing actor. NCSC UK named the bootkit RayInitiator and the loader LINE VIPER, seen on ASA 5500-X without Secure Boot.

class: Authentication bypass via alternate path (cloud SSO trust)
impact: Admin login to other customers' devices that have FortiCloud SSO enabled; attackers created admin accounts and exfiltrated configs
notes: Advisory FG-IR-26-060. The 9.8 is Fortinet's CNA score as shown on NVD; some sources say 9.4. KEV ransomware field is 'Unknown'. It hit devices already patched for CVE-2025-59718 (Dec 2025). FortiCloud SSO is off by default but gets enabled when a device is registered to FortiCare through the GUI. This is the admin plane, not the SSL-VPN.

class: Information exposure (bypass of the anti-symlink-persistence patch)
impact: On an already-compromised device, read files through the leftover symlink despite Fortinet's cleanup patch
exploitedFirst: UNVERIFIED (KEV lists it; vendor page says 'Known Exploited: No')
notes: Advisory FG-IR-25-934. Only works after an earlier compromise has planted the symlink. FortiOS 7.2, 7.0 and 6.4 have no in-branch fix, so they must migrate. KEV ransomware field is 'Unknown'. The KEV listing conflicts with the vendor's 'Known Exploited: No'.

class: Out-of-bounds memory read (two overread bugs under one CVE)
impact: Leak appliance memory, potentially including admin session IDs, without logging in
notes: Bulletin CTX696300. NVD v3.1 is 9.8. CVSS v4 is 9.3. Only appliances configured as a SAML IdP are affected. watchTowr found two separate overreads and saw honeypot exploitation by 2026-03-27. A PoC repo calls it 'NetScalerBleed2', which is not an established nickname. KEV ransomware field is 'Unknown'.

product: PAN-OS GlobalProtect portal/gateway (and some Prisma Access)
impact: Establish an unauthorized VPN connection without valid credentials (and so without MFA)
notes: NVD v3.1 is 9.1. The vendor scores it CVSS v4 7.8, raised from 4.7 on 2026-05-29. It requires the authentication-override cookie feature (not on by default) plus a specific certificate setup. Unit 42 (updated 2026-10-19) named Qilin and Inc operators, per secondary coverage; the Unit 42 brief was not read directly.

product: Quantum Security Gateway Remote Access VPN / Mobile Access / Spark (IKEv1)
class: Improper authentication (certificate-validation logic flaw in legacy IKEv1)
impact: Establish a remote-access VPN session without a valid password
notes: Advisory sk185033. Affects only deprecated IKEv1 setups that accept legacy clients without requiring a machine certificate. Check Point linked one incident to a Qilin affiliate (medium confidence) and called the campaign limited, at several dozen organizations (via Rapid7).

class: Server-side request forgery (chained with CVE-2026-15410 code injection)
impact: Unauthenticated access to internal-only services; with CVE-2026-15410, root code execution
notes: Advisory SNWLID-2026-0008. The CVSS 10.0 comes from secondary coverage (Tenable); the vendor page was not read. CVE-2026-15410 is post-auth, CVSS 7.2, and was also added to KEV on 2026-07-14 with the ransomware flag 'Known'. SSL-VPN on SonicWall firewalls and SMA 100 are not affected.

product: NetScaler ADC / Gateway (Gateway or AAA vserver, SAML)
class: Heap memory overflow in SAML processing
impact: Vendor rates it DoS; public research shows unauthenticated RCE and attackers dropping web shells
exploitedFirst: 2026-08 (n-day, after watchTowr research 2026-08-14; exact date UNVERIFIED)
notes: Bulletin CTX696604 (secondary). CVSS v3 is UNVERIFIED: Citrix CVSS v4 8.8 is per secondary, and one source cites NVD v3.1 9.8. KEV ransomware field is 'Unknown'.

class: Authentication bypass by spoofing plus RCE (third privilege-escalation bug in the chain still unpatched)
impact: Unauthenticated root-level code execution on a fully patched appliance (when chained)
notes: Actor UTA0576, assessed criminal with low confidence. No malware was dropped: the actor re-exploited for every command, tampered with logs, and the Integrity Checker Tool did not detect it. Stolen data included LAPS passwords, BitLocker recovery keys and LDAP credentials. As of 2026-10-23 the privilege-escalation fix was reported still pending (secondary). KEV ransomware field is 'Unknown'.
